summary:
Results-driven Data analyst with 4+ years of experience delivering data solutions that increased business
performance by 30%. Expert in developing interactive dashboards and building ETL workflows that reduced manual
reporting time by 30%. Proven track record in translating complex datasets into actionable business insights using
Power BI, SQL, Python, VBA and Azure Data Factory.

bullets: A data analytics and tech consulting company that provides BI, analytics, and data-driven solutions to businesses.
Developed interactive Power BI dashboards for financial and hedge fund analytics, tracking portfolio performance, investment exposure, and financial KPIs.
Designed data models (Star Schema) and built advanced DAX measures for KPI calculations, improving dashboard performance and analytical insights.
Built ETL pipelines using Azure Data Factory, SQL Server, and Power Query to integrate and transform data from multiple sources.
Applying SQL and Python to clean, transform, and analyse datasets for performance metrics.
Implemented Row-Level Security (RLS) and governance policies to ensure secure and role-based data access.
Designed and optimized Power BI dashboards for mobile and tablet view using responsive layouts and mobile-friendly visual configurations.
Delivered financial, insurance, and operational dashboards with drill-through analysis, dynamic filters, and KPI visuals for business stakeholders.
Automated manual reporting processes in Excel using VBA, improving efficiency and accuracy in weekly data refresh cycles.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, perform data validation, and deliver data-driven insights for strategic decision-making.
Developed and maintained interactive Power BI and Tableau dashboards for market, recruitment, insurance, and financial performance reporting.
Designed and developed user-friendly Power BI dashboards by translating Figma and Canva prototypes into interactive reporting solutions with modern UI/UX design standards.
A company focused on delivering credit reporting and finance dashboard development
Supported development and maintenance of Power BI dashboards for financial reporting and credit bureau analytics, analysing Bloomberg market data and financial KPIs.
Extracted and transformed financial datasets using SQL Server (SSMS), Power Query, and APIs, ensuring accurate data integration and reporting.
Built DAX measures, calculated columns, and KPI visuals for credit risk, portfolio exposure, and financial performance analysis.
Performed data validation and reconciliation using Python (Pandas) and SQL to ensure consistency between source systems and BI reports.
Assisted in data modelling, dataset refresh optimization, and ad-hoc financial reporting for business stakeholders.
A technology company specializing in data-driven solution and reporting analytics
Collected, cleaned, and analysed large datasets using Python-pandas and NumPy to derive actionable business insights.
Developed interactive dashboards in Power BI to track portfolio performance, cost analysis, and broker interactions, improving data visibility for hedge fund portfolio managers.
Automated data transformation and reporting using Power Query and Python, reducing manual effort by 30% and increasing reporting accuracy.
Performed internal vs. external data comparison analysis to assess portfolio performance against market trends.
Coordinated with U.S.-based clients, attending late-night meetings to align analytical insights with their business needs.
Extracted and analysed coverage information from top brokers, creating detailed quarterly reports to support financial decision-making.
